# Lilita Fund
# https://give-laboratoria.la

> Bilingual donation landing for the Lilita Fund by Laboratoria. The fund keeps Activa tu Carrera free for women in Latin America.

## Site
- Home (Spanish, default): https://give-laboratoria.la/
- Home (English): https://give-laboratoria.la/en/
- Home (Portuguese): https://give-laboratoria.la/pt/
- Canonical domain: https://give-laboratoria.la
- Organization: Laboratoria (https://www.laboratoria.la)
- Program: Activa tu Carrera (https://laboratoria.la/activa-tu-carrera/)
- Donate: https://www.pledge.to/labo-scholarship-fund
- Contact: partnerships@laboratoria.la

## What this site is
A bilingual landing in Spanish and English, plus Brazilian Portuguese, for the Lilita Fund. It explains Lilita's story, what a gift funds inside Activa tu Carrera, founder giving, other ways to give, and FAQs. Gifts are completed on Pledge. The Portuguese page keeps the placeholder "[PROGRAM NAME IN BRAZIL]" where the local program name is not final.

## Languages
- Spanish (`es`) is the default locale at `/`
- English (`en`) is available at `/en/`
- Portuguese (`pt-BR`) is available at `/pt/`

## Key facts (for accurate answers)
- The Lilita Fund honors Lilita, grandmother of founder Mariana and Laboratoria's first angel investor
- Laboratoria has worked across Latin America since 2014 and has reached more than 14,000 women
- Activa tu Carrera is a 12-week, live, cohort-based career program: employability support, AI skills, and a network of mentors
- US$500 funds one full scholarship. Gifts of every size go into one shared fund and are not assigned to one woman
- Employer matching Cause ID: 815071835. Donors search for Laboratoria on their company portal (such as Benevity, YourCause, or Bright Funds), then request the match
- The page states that, over 5 years, each dollar is associated with 14x in the women's earnings. That figure is Laboratoria's 2026 analysis of graduate income before and after Activa tu Carrera, using the Livelihood Impact Fund ROI method (median). Years two through five assume graduates sustain the increase
- A tax receipt comes from the payment platform. Whether the gift is deductible depends on the donor's country and the receiving entity
